commands.name: archive_set_format
commands.description: Chooses the format Keka makes archives in, with the Format pop-up in Keka's window.

args.name: format
args.meaning: zip, tar, 7z, gzip, bzip2, xz, dmg or iso.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": Keka's scripting hung in testing.

example_requests: Set the archive format to ZIP
commands.precondition: The program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events.
commands.postcondition: Keka makes archives in that format until it's changed.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a named element never appeared, or the change wasn't seen in time

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: Keka shows a dialog with typed text, or another app came to the front; nothing is changed

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "background": Keka's scripting hung in testing

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 with Keka 1.6.0 only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
It depends on English names and was tested only in English.
It needs Keka's main window (the one with the Format pop-up); if it was closed, the command raises UIError.
Only zip, tar and 7z were chosen in testing, and only zip and tar archives were made.

commands.name: archive_create
commands.description: Makes an archive of items in the same folder in Keka's current format, saved next to them.

args.name: paths
args.meaning: Absolute paths (or starting with ~) of items in the same folder.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": Keka's scripting hung in testing.

example_requests: Zip these two files with Keka
Make a TAR of this folder
commands.precondition: The program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events.
commands.postcondition: A new archive next to the items holds them; the items stay.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a named element never appeared, or the change wasn't seen in time

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: Keka shows a dialog with typed text, or another app came to the front; nothing is changed

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: nothing is at a path; nothing is made

errors.name: AlreadyExists
errors.when: Keka proposes a name that's taken; nothing is made

errors.name: OutsideAllowedRoot
errors.when: KEKA_ALLOWED_ROOT is set and a path is outside it; nothing is done

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "background", or Keka is closed or hidden; nothing is done

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 with Keka 1.6.0 only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
Only touches what KEKA_ALLOWED_ROOT allows if it is set; if it isn't set, any item you can reach is accepted.
It depends on English names and was tested only in English.
It needs Keka's main window (the one with the Format pop-up); if it was closed, the command raises UIError.
It raises NotSupported while Keka is closed or hidden, because items handed to it then were dropped in testing; open Keka first.
The items are opened with Keka, which asks where to save because it has no access to the folder; the dialog is filled in by name.
The archive's name is Keka's own: the item's name for one item, Archive for several, numbered if taken.
Compression level, passwords and splitting are left as Keka has them; TAR is made uncompressed.

commands.name: archive_extract
commands.description: Expands an archive next to itself: it is opened with Keka, and Keka's folder dialog is answered with the archive's own folder.

args.name: path
args.meaning: An absolute path (or starting with ~) to a .zip, .tar, .7z, .gz, .tgz, .bz2, .xz or .rar.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": Keka's scripting hung in testing.

commands.precondition: The program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events.
commands.postcondition: The archive's items are next to it; the archive stays.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a named element never appeared, or the change wasn't seen in time

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: Keka shows a dialog with typed text, or another app came to the front; nothing is changed

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: nothing is at the path; nothing is done

errors.name: OutsideAllowedRoot
errors.when: KEKA_ALLOWED_ROOT is set and the path is outside it; nothing is done

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "background", or Keka is closed or hidden; nothing is done

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 with Keka 1.6.0 only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
Only touches what KEKA_ALLOWED_ROOT allows if it is set; if it isn't set, any item you can reach is accepted.
It depends on English names and was tested only in English.
It raises NotSupported while Keka is closed or hidden, like archive_create; open Keka first.
Keka asks for a folder to extract to only when it has none it may use there; the archive's own folder is chosen.
Only zip and TAR were tested; where Keka puts a clashing name is its own choice.
